title: Derived residue model from an affine free section complex
statement: Let W be a scheme, w a point, and E an object of its derived category, with fixed derived localizations on all schemes and localized open module sites [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-derived-category]. Let U be an affine open containing w and K a cochain complex on the localized module site of U, with each term isomorphic to the free sheaf of finite rank r(j), for a function r: Z -> N [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Assume the restriction of E to U is isomorphic to Q(K). Let F evaluate module sheaves on the terminal over-object (U,id). Assume the explicit section complex P = F(K) is K-flat [def-pc-module-kflat-complex]. Let C be the complex obtained by applying F and then extending scalars along the residue evaluation Gamma(W,U) -> kappa(w) [def-weil-residue-field]. Then the derived pullback of E along the residue point Spec kappa(w) -> W [def-pc-derived-pullback] is isomorphic in the derived category of module sheaves on Spec kappa(w) to Q of the termwise associated sheaf of C. This is an object comparison before taking cohomology.

source.place: Tags 01IB (affine associated sheaves), 064K (bounded above flat K-flatness), 08DW(2) (affine derived pullback), 06YI and 06YJ (derived pullback and composition), 0098 (stalks of pullback)

proof.text: Transport K through the over-site equivalence to modules on U.toScheme. Finite free terms are quasi-coherent. Apply affine_projective_sections_sheafification to the identity quasi-isomorphism of its section complex. The affine section comparison and naturality identify these sections with the terminal-over-object evaluation used to define F; hence the sheafified section complex and K give isomorphic derived objects. Transport this comparison through the localized-site derived equivalence.

Factor the residue point through U. Apply the affine K-flat pullback chart comparison to the section complex, and apply derived pullback composition and exact open restriction to the supplied isomorphism he. These identify Li_w^* E with the associated sheaf of the termwise residue extension of the section complex. The chart ring map sends a section to its germ followed by residue, hence is W.evaluation U w hwU. Transport along the spectrum field chart gives exactly the displayed Q(tilde C). No homology comparison is used in this step.

proof_origin.note: Affine presentation and pullback portion of the original proof. K-flatness is now supplied by the original module, which proves it from the support bound and finite free section coordinates; that module also proves the exact-section and homology comparison.

theorem affineFree_residueSections_derivedModel
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (E : schemeDerivedCategory W) (w : W) (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U)
    (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (K : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (r : ℤ → ℕ)
    (hrank : ∀ j : ℤ, Nonempty (K.X j ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{v} (Fin (r j)))))
    (he : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
      (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)) :
    let F : SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U) ⥤ ModuleCat.{v} Γ(W, U) :=
      SheafOfModules.evaluation _ (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
    letI : F.Additive := inferInstanceAs
      ((SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ _).Additive)
    let P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} Γ(W, U)) ℤ :=
      (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K
    let T := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{v, v, v} (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom
    letI : T.Additive := (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj _).left_adjoint_additive
    let C := ((F ⋙ T).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K
    let L := tilde.functor (W.residueField w)
    letI : L.PreservesZeroMorphisms := ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩
    (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{v} Γ(W, U)) (.up ℤ)).kFlat P →
    Nonempty ((derivedPullback (W.fromSpecResidueField w)).obj E ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C))
